document_data.title: Referral Letter to Dr. Kim for Brian Turner
document_data.content:
Dear Dr. Kim,

I am writing to refer Brian Turner for further assessment. During his recent workplace fitness evaluation, we noted that he has chronic knee pain, which may hinder his ability to perform certain duties safely and effectively. He has requested that we maintain confidentiality regarding his evaluation results and avoid external referrals or sharing this information outside the clinic team, as noted in the previous documentation.

Please conduct a thorough evaluation at your earliest convenience to determine the best approach for managing his knee pain and any accommodations that may be necessary.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Dr. Ana Rivera
Riverside Family Health
